topic: A homeowner discovers previous residents left items in the attic
text: Well, imagine my surprise when I ventured into the attic for the first time. Dust motes dancing in the slanting light, sure, but that wasn’t all. Amidst the old trunks and half-forgotten Christmas decorations, there were piles of stuff left behind by the last folks who called this place home. A framed tapestry, some old books, and even a suitcase with clothes that looked like they stepped right out of a vintage movie. It was like they decided to leave a piece of their story behind, hidden in this attic. Curious, isn’t it? Makes me wonder about their lives, their reasons for leaving without all this. I guess in a way, I’m now caretaker of their secrets too.
